text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, over here next! Looks like the 
eggplants are ready to harvest~!

The vegetables planted earlier with 
Katsuragi Ace and Chairwoman Akikawa were 
reaching harvest time one after another.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Oooh! That's quite a haul~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't look like the two of us can finish 
all this— Guess we'll go hand 'em out to 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Oh, Palmer! Perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
We had a huge vegetable harvest. Would you 
mind taking some off my hands?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you as always~! Ehehe, I'm gonna 
cook something for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Um, Helios and Jordan eat junk food so 
often, I just couldn't leave them alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Still, I feel kinda bad getting so much... 
—Oh, I know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Here, this is a thank-you gift for you! 
There are a few cupcakes inside.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I won this as a prize in a golf 
tournament, so consider it a thank-you for 
sharing with me!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? Heheh, then I'll gladly take 
it!

"Next, upon visiting the cafeteria, I 
found Hokko Tarumae treating many students 
to haskap jam."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Gather 'round, come one, come all! It's a 
tasting session for Tomakomai specialties, 
don'tcha know~♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! Ace-san and Ace-san's Trainer! Would 
you like some haskap jam?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that looks delicious! Since we're 
here, maybe I'll take one—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I know! Wouldn't this jam go great with 
those cupcakes from earlier?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ? A cupcake?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I ended up with these for reasons. 
Let's all share 'em together.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, so good! The sweet and sour with the 
sweetness goes so well together~~♪
choice_data_list:
Looks like it's a big hit with everyone 
else too!

Looks like it's a big hit with everyone 
else too!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Thanks to you, so many people came to 
eat. Please take this as a token of my 
gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A Tomakomai specialty, surf clams—in a 
can!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Canned food?! Whoa~, they have that kind 
of thing too?! Thanks, Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I've ever eaten canned surf 
clam before... How do you eat it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —Oh my, isn't that—?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Canned surf clams!! The ones from PriFie 
episode 31— popularly known as the cooking 
episode!! Those canned surf clams, right!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you startled me...! I-Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's a story about inventing a new 
menu item, the 'Surf Clam Burger,' for a 
troubled restaurant owner—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I've been wanting to cook it with my own 
hands and recreate it someday...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Um... you want it then? I was just 
wondering how I was gonna eat it.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure?! Then please take this from 
me as well!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —Dosseeeei!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Wh-Gah!!? What the hell was that?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: They are roof tiles!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you can put it in your bag for weight 
training anytime, or use it for 
practically anything else! Here you go♪

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Roof tiles, roof tiles, huh...?! 
What the heck am I supposed to do with 
this thing—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Wait, roof tiles!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Please take this as a token of my 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "This is...— Ah, a bulb!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, these are tulip bulbs. Knowing how 
skilled you are at growing crops, Ace-san, 
I thought you might put them to good use.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I'm glad! I wasn't super familiar 
with it, but I'm definitely interested!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Yaeno. I promise I'll make it 
bloom beautifully!

And so, the straw millionaire trade that 
began with a humble vegetable came to an 
end with a tulip bulb.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, hole's dug! Go ahead and plant 
the bulb here.

I planted tulip bulbs in the spots where 
Katsuragi Ace had dug up the soil.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Still... heheh, today was a really fun 
day!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Handing out veggies is something I do all 
the time, but this is the first time 
something like this has happened.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“How should I put it, when I'm with you, 
Trainer, I feel like fun things just 
naturally find their way to us.”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. For example, when the two of us 
talk like this, we get excited and our 
voices get louder, right?”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And then, someone who overhears will join 
in the conversation, making it even more 
fun, you know?

Talking with her certainly brightens my 
mood naturally. I can completely 
understand why everyone gathers around 
her.
choice_data_list: I have fun being with you, too.
I have fun when I'm with you, too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I see! I hope these tulips are 
having fun too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Oh, come to think of it—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Has this fig sapling over here gotten a 
bit bigger too?

The fig sapling planted earlier. It looked 
fragile when it was first planted, but it 
seems to have grown sturdier for sure.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yup, I gotta take good care of this little 
guy too!
